status: frozen targets; not a measured performance pass

hostBaseline.storage: local APFS SSD; record volume/free bytes and Docker volume filesystem at each run; disk throughput not prequalified

runResources.service: native packaged Java 21, dedicated process; no other Sanctity qualification running
runResources.source: new private root; synthetic files only
runResources.measurement: capture JVM RSS/heap/direct buffers, Docker stats, pg_stat_activity/stat_statements/plans, filesystem reserves, queue/stream counters at 1 Hz

sampling.quantile: nearest-rank p95 over every admitted request; retain full raw samples and refused/timeout counts separately
sampling.coldDefinition: new JVM + new PostgreSQL process from identical seeded snapshot; host/VM filesystem cache may be warm and must be labelled process-cold
sampling.filesystemCold: separate optional run only when cache eviction or fresh VM/volume is actually demonstrated; no claim from process restart
sampling.abortCondition: any integrity or disclosure mismatch immediately fails qualification; retain failing state and samples
sampling.durationRule: Continue until both duration and every required sample minimum are met; inadequate samples fail, never substitute a lower-rate class.
sampling.personaRule: Measure eligible persona/operation pairs; measure deliberate denials separately with the same latency/error accounting.

historyGrowth.sampledMutations: each run continues history without modifying frozen historical releases; reset from same seed between independent runs

correctness.identityMapping: bind logical dataset/Rn labels to returned immutable IDs while seeding; compare oracle content/queries/actions, never learn expected answers from service results
correctness.authority: explicit fixture answers follow ADR002; primary placement/inheritance, linked-without-access, fixed R1, metadata-only, archival, revocation/expiry/disabled principals
correctness.query: T1w; Siemens AND participant age >= 40; exact path sets and authorized totals, page ordering lexicographic(dataset,path)
correctness.history: only dataset_description changes per revision; historical bytes and query hits stable
correctness.boundary: exact 10000 source entries includes directories; 10001 refuses before durable operation/managed bytes; never split automatically
correctness.cursor: cross-user, tamper, expiry, cross-query, and revocation after first page deny without cached rows/counts
correctness.export: canonical JSON mapping(path -> {sha256,size}) digest; archives additionally compare decoded entries, no dependence on archive timestamp/header bytes

changeControl.rule: Any reduction of corpus, sampling, scope or budget requires a new version, reason, old/new comparison, mote note and full affected requalification; preserve prior failures.
changeControl.institutional: Q01.1/Q01.3 qualify permitted institutional corpus and accepted targets separately.
